We report a young woman who ﬁrst presented with un-
explained weight loss and cerebellar dysfunction. Subse-
quently, tests revealed anti-GAD antibodies both in serum
and in CSF. She was treated with steroids, intravenous
immunoglobulins, rituximab, and mycophenolate mofetil.
Five years later, while being treated with steroids (10mg
daily) and mycophenolate mofetil (500mg twice a day), she
developed signs and symptoms consistent with stiﬀ person
syndrome. -%_his case report highlights the possibility of
sequential neurological syndromes due to anti-GAD
antibodies.
